footer.commitment: Skillable is committed to providing an inclusive experience. We aim to align with WCAG 2.1 Level A/AA where possible and continuously improve.

home.heroSubtitle: Skillable matches you to careers using your actual profile — disabilities included, never excluded.
home.threeSteps: Three steps to your next opportunity

01.title: Build your profile
01.body: Set your accessibility needs, experience level, and skills. The more detail, the sharper your matches.

02.title: Get matched
02.body: Our algorithm scores every career across disability accommodation, skill overlap, and experience fit.

03.title: Start learning
03.body: Pick a track, follow the roadmap, fill skill gaps with curated resources — at your own pace.

realWorld.title: Career support that starts with the person, not the limitation
realWorld.body: Skillable brings profile building, accessible career matching, learning pathways, open roles, and CV preparation into one clear experience. The goal is simple: help people understand where they fit, what skills to build, and how to take the next practical step.
realWorld.imageText: Support for people, families, educators, and inclusive employers working toward fairer opportunities.

labels.accessible: Designed around accessibility from the first screen
labels.pathways: Practical work pathways with guided next steps

today.title: A complete path from profile to opportunity
today.body: The landing page should make it obvious that Skillable is not only a chatbot. It is a career platform with matching, preparation, learning, and job discovery working together.

match.title: Discover suitable careers
match.body: Compare your skills, experience, and accessibility needs against career paths that make sense for you.

learn.title: Follow work pathways
learn.body: Use structured steps and resources to prepare for practical roles in the Egyptian market.

cv.title: Create a focused CV
cv.body: Build a resume that highlights skills, training, projects, tools, and strengths.

roles.title: Explore open roles
roles.body: Browse opportunities and understand what employers are asking for before applying.

inclusion.title: Accessibility is part of the workflow, not a separate extra
inclusion.body: Skillable keeps accessibility visible across the experience: profile fields, matching logic, interface controls, bilingual content, and guidance that helps users communicate needs clearly and confidently.

accessPoints.profile: Profile fields cover mobility, vision, hearing, cognitive needs, skills, and experience.
accessPoints.matching: Career matching considers accessibility fit alongside skills and experience.
accessPoints.tools: Interface tools support contrast, font size, reduced motion, and speech focus.
accessPoints.language: Arabic and English support helps users move through the platform comfortably.

vision.title: From graduation project to national inclusion initiative
vision.body: Skillable is designed with a long-term vision: to become a nonprofit initiative that improves how persons with disabilities access career guidance, skills, and employment opportunities. The aim is not only to build a platform, but to support a more organized and inclusive pathway from ability to work.
vision.statementBody: Our future goal is to collaborate with governmental entities, universities, civil society organizations, and inclusive employers so Skillable can scale responsibly across Egypt and support people in different governorates.

policy.title: Government collaboration
policy.body: Work with public-sector and institutional partners to align the platform with national inclusion and employment priorities.

partnership.title: Shared ecosystem
partnership.body: Connect job seekers, educators, recruiters, and support organizations around one accessible career journey.

scale.title: Nationwide reach
scale.body: Expand beyond a single university project into a service that can support People of Determination across Egypt.

seekers.title: For job seekers
seekers.body: Skillable helps users understand their strengths, prepare a profile, build a CV, explore career paths, and move toward roles that fit their abilities and needs.

employers.title: For inclusive employers
employers.body: Recruiters and organizations can post open roles, describe requirements clearly, and connect with candidates who are preparing for suitable opportunities.

home.aiSubtitle: Ask me anything about your career
home.aiEmptyMsg: Ask about jobs, accessibility laws, interview tips, or anything career-related.
home.simplifierSubtitle: Paste any job description or document. We'll rewrite it in plain, clear language.

matching.title: Egyptians of every ability, side by side
matching.body: Skillable is for everyday Egyptian life: people with disabilities studying, working, travelling, and building independence with their families, friends, and communities around them.

tracks.title: Skills that work in the Egyptian market
tracks.body: Build practical skills employers ask for in Egypt: Microsoft Office, Arabic and English communication, data entry, customer support chat, basic accounting, digital marketing, coding, design, and remote-work habits.

ai.title: Prepare for interviews with confidence
ai.body: Get help explaining your needs clearly, asking for reasonable accommodations, preparing a short self-introduction, and answering common interview questions in a way that focuses on ability and readiness.

textTools.title: Understand forms and job posts
textTools.body: Paste a job post, training announcement, or government form and turn it into clear steps. Useful when wording is formal, crowded, or hard to follow.

cv.title: Show what you can do
cv.body: Create a clean CV that highlights strengths, training, tools you can use, languages, volunteering, and projects. Keep disability details optional and focus on skills, reliability, and fit.

remote.title: Workplaces that can open real doors
remote.body: Many factories, call centers, retailers, offices, and service companies in Egypt can offer suitable roles for people with disabilities, from packaging and quality checks to chat support, data entry, design, and admin work.

placeholders.about: Describe the role, work environment, accessibility notes, and what the person will do.

sidebar.reachTitle: Reach candidates who are ready to work
sidebar.reachBody: Your role appears in Open Roles where Skillable users can apply with their skills, motivation, contact details, and accessibility notes in one place.
sidebar.liveRoleBody: The job gets its own public role page with clear requirements and a focused apply button.
sidebar.applicantBody: Applications are saved under the role so the recruiter can review people who fit the job.
sidebar.contactBody: Each application includes email, phone, skills, CV link, and why the person wants to join.
sidebar.tipTasks: Write the daily tasks clearly, not only the job title.
sidebar.tipAccess: Mention if training, remote work, flexible shifts, or accessible transport are available.
sidebar.tipRealistic: Keep requirements realistic so beginner-friendly roles stay beginner-friendly.
sidebar.bestForBody: Factories, call centers, offices, NGOs, retailers, and training providers hiring people with disabilities in Egypt.
